scope: Final aggregate inventory editorial clarifications for fifteen completed longer proofs. Existing detailed accepted reports/evidence remain immutable.

rows.original_how: Additive polynomial induction; monomial coefficient evaluation; distinguish reconstructed exponent, dominating order and vanishing binomial cases.
rows.how: Induct on the polynomial with MvPolynomial.induction_on'; use hasseDeriv_monomial and hasseCoeff_eq_zero_iff to separate reconstructed exponents from out-of-range vanishing, then distribute across addition.

rows.original_how: Computes each permutation-product coefficient using individual Hasse degree bounds; excessive derivative orders make both sides zero; sums the signed determinant expansions.
rows.how: Use coeff_prod_of_natDegree_le' and natDegree_hasseDeriv_le on each permutation product; hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree handles excessive orders, then Matrix.det_apply' sums the signed terms.

rows.original_how: Derives translated residual support independence, applies coefficient separation and the one-variable binomial theorem, then factors binomial and power products.
rows.how: Separate residual-variable support with coeff_aeval_X_mul, apply Polynomial.coeff_X_add_C_pow to the one-variable factor, and combine hasseCoeff_single_add_eq with prod_pow_single_add_tsub.

rows.original_how: Coefficient ≤ coefficient length; support length ≤ box cardinality times B; each Hasse derivative length grows by at most2^S; expand determinant into l! products; scalar ring normalization.
rows.how: Apply abs_coeff_le_normOne, normOne_det_le and normOne_hasseDeriv_le; normOne_le_card_mul and card_le_card_box control the input size before scalar normalization.

rows.original_how: Expand into monomials and isolate the coefficient using bounded positional injectivity.
rows.how: Expand P.as_sum through kronecker_monomial, then use Finset.sum_eq_single and kroneckerExp_injOn to isolate the uniquely encoded bounded exponent.

rows.original_how: Choose bounded injective Kronecker substitution, use univariate nonvanishing, expand higher substituted derivatives and determinant, contradict simultaneous vanishing.
rows.how: Choose bounded Kronecker substitutions using exists_hasseDeriv_kronecker_eq_sum; combine linearIndependent_kronecker with wronskian_ne_zero_of_linearIndependent, and expand via wronskian_kronecker_eq_sum_aux to contradict vanishing of every candidate determinant.

rows.original_how: Pair j with r−j to obtain rational endpoint bound; compare 1−λ⁻² with √(1−1/m), then normalize roots/inverses.
rows.how: Apply sum_inv_le for the paired endpoint bound, use sqrt_one_sub_inv_lt for the strict comparison, and normalize the square-root quotient with Real.sqrt_div'.

rows.original_how: Dimension induction; trivial total-count regime; empty zero/one-dimensional cases; last-coordinate fibres and shifted reciprocal sum in large-tail regime.
rows.how: Induct on dimension; filter_weight_le_eq_empty handles zero and one-dimensional empty cases, card_filter_weight_le_of_le_sqrt_aux handles the trivial count regime, and card_filter_weight_le_succ_aux combines the fibre bound with induction.

rows.original_how: Convert Hasse evaluations to coefficients of the univariate Taylor expansion; use least nonzero coefficient and nonnegative division.
rows.how: Use uniqueAlgEquiv_hasseDeriv and Polynomial.taylor_coeff to identify Hasse evaluations with Taylor coefficients; Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree, index_le_weight and le_index_iff compare both bounds using the least nonzero coefficient.

rows.original_how: Split the multi-index into disjoint supports, compose Hasse operators, pull out factors of degree zero in the active variables, and transport each factor derivative through its embedding.
rows.how: Split the derivative multi-index into disjoint supports via hasseDeriv_hasseDeriv_of_disjoint; hasseDeriv_mul_of_degreeOf_eq_zero pulls out inactive factors, and hasseDeriv_single_aeval_X plus hasseDeriv_rename transport the two derivatives.

rows.original_how: Choose a finite basis of coefficient-polynomial span; build independent univariate coordinate polynomials; reconstruct by basis expansion and preserve support-box degrees.
rows.how: Expand coefficients by eq_sum_X_none_pow_mul_coeffNone, choose a bounded basis with exists_coeffNone_basis_aux, prove coordinate independence via linearIndependent_coordinate_polynomials_aux, and reconstruct with eq_sum_aeval_basis_coeffNone_aux.

rows.original_how: Identify entries with an embedded A·Bᵀ using factorwise separated Hasse differentiation and linearity; apply determinant multiplicativity, transpose invariance and AlgHom determinant transport.
rows.how: Use hasseDeriv_rename_mul_aeval to identify the derivative matrix as an embedded product; Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose and AlgHom.map_det then give the two determinant factors.

rows.original_how: Product of positive coefficient denominators on finite support, integer scaled coefficients, reconstruction and coefficient extensionality.
rows.how: Take the product of coefficient denominators on finite support using Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem; Rat.den_mul_eq_num supplies integer scaled coefficients and Rat.den_pos ensures a positive common denominator, then reconstruct by coefficient extensionality.

rows.original_how: Use finite Bezout coefficients, choose integer product witnesses, and take their integer weighted sum; the generic proof uses submodule closure under finite sums/scalars.
rows.how: Use exists_sum_mul_eq_gcd for finite Bezout coefficients, choose integer product witnesses, and distribute their weighted sum with Finset.sum_mul to construct the integer scalar witness.

rows.original_how: Primitive linear-factor descent through Gauss lemma, compare nonzero integer leading coefficients and cast.
